summary: First iteration MVP testing of NutriSmart app. Found and fixed 2 critical bugs: (1) Register endpoint returning 422 due to unused `response: 'Response'` forward-ref parameter in FastAPI signature treated as required query param, (2) Checkout page redirecting to /menu instead of /order-confirmation after payment due to clearCart() being called before navigate(), which triggered empty-cart guard re-render. Both bugs fixed. All 19 backend tests pass. All major frontend flows verified working.

issues: Admin user (no BMI data) redirects to /bmi-setup after login instead of /menu or /admin - admin users shouldn't need BMI setup

action_items: Admin users should be redirected to /admin or /menu after login, not /bmi-setup (BMI is irrelevant for admins)
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: server.py register() had `response: 'Response'` string annotation causing FastAPI to treat it as required query param → removed unused parameter

FIXED: CheckoutPage.jsx clearCart() called before navigate() caused empty-cart guard to trigger navigate('/menu') overriding order-confirmation redirect → added orderPlaced state flag + navigate first then clearCart

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all major flows work; minor admin redirect issue)

seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 20 menu items, demo user with BMI data, admin user, and 2 demo orders on startup
mocked_apis: Payment is MOCKED via /api/payment/mock - always returns success with MOCK-{id} transaction ID
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both critical bugs fixed. Backend 100% passing. All flows tested: landing page, demo/admin login, signup+BMI setup, menu with filters/recommendations (AI tip working), cart, checkout, order-confirmation (MOCK-txn shown), dashboard (BMI card + calorie chart + order history), admin panel (menu management + orders tab). Only minor issue: admin redirected to /bmi-setup after login.

bug1_register_422.root_cause: FastAPI route `async def register(data: RegisterRequest, response: 'Response')` - the string annotation 'Response' is not recognized as a FastAPI injectable Response dependency, so it becomes a required query parameter named 'response'. All POST requests without ?response= query param return 422.
bug1_register_422.fix: Removed unused `response` parameter from function signature. The function already creates JSONResponse internally.

bug2_checkout_redirect.root_cause: In CheckoutPage.jsx, `clearCart()` was called before `navigate()`. CartContext state update triggers re-render of CheckoutPage where line 16 `if (cart.length === 0) { navigate('/menu') }` fires, overriding the intended navigation to /order-confirmation.
bug2_checkout_redirect.fix: Added `orderPlaced` state flag, set it to true before navigate. Modified early-exit guard to `if (cart.length === 0 && !orderPlaced)`. Navigate is called before clearCart.
